description: This file defines a template function for generating email content related to event ratings, including HTML and plain text versions, with dynamic data insertion and localization.

methods.name: emailRatingTemplate
methods.description: Generates an email subject and body HTML string based on event details, user locale, and other parameters, with support for editing mode and branding options.

methods.name: plainTextTemplate
methods.description: Provides a plain text version of the email template with placeholders for dynamic data.
